prologue: Seen from behind on a rocky ridge, the pilot watches a line of smooth stone statues, each with both arms raised, recede across a lavender plain toward a glowing brass machine.
part-01: In a cathedral-like weaving hall, the pilot holds a glowing punched card up to the light, her tablet under her arm, while weavers work at a towering loom beneath looping chains of cards.
part-02: Across a canyon, a sealed gray fortress faces an open wooden scaffold full of workers, joined by a thin bridge. The pilot flies her red craft between them.
part-03: A gear-filled iron gateway stands alone on an ochre plain. The pilot walks a wooden catwalk through it toward a low sun.
part-04: The pilot rides her red craft in the foreground, her face turned toward the viewer. Behind her, tall phone-shaped slabs cabled to a relay mast rise from the lavender plain.
part-05: A grand building shown in cross-section. On the left, its elegant facade, with the pilot on a small balcony. On the right, the wall is cut away to reveal floors crowded with pipes, gauges and machines.
part-06: A bald brass butler robot in a black tailcoat pulls a lever beside the lamp-lit control tower at the center of a great conveyor ring. The pilot sits on the rim nearby, reading her tablet.
part-07: At the edge of an empty theater stage, a tall silver robot with a glowing gold eye raises one hand. The pilot watches from among the rows of red seats.
part-08: The pilot stands on her red craft holding her tablet and looks at a slender silver robot with glowing gold eyes, which holds a glowing brass lantern by its ring handle beside a cliff face full of doorways.
part-09: Seen from above, the pilot climbs a pale stone spiral staircase with a different machine on each landing, while a small brass automaton points her onward.
part-10: The pilot flies her red craft past in the foreground. Behind her, rival spires fly a red flag and a blue flag, and a shaft of gold light falls on the bridge being built between them.
part-11: The pilot walks away from the viewer through an arc of carved stone plinths toward a large low gold sun, her tablet in one hand.
part-12: In a workshop above the clouds, a blank sheet and a pen lie on an empty desk. The pilot stands at a tall window, tablet at her side, looking out at distant planets.
epilogue: At dusk on the lavender plain, the pilot sits on the nose of her red craft with her tablet, while a line of small lights leads to the horizon.
